newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Shi'ite leader shot dead in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Shi'ite leader shot dead in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a local Shi'ite Moslem leader on Friday in the Pakistani town of Derya Khan, in Punjab province, police said.
They said two men on a motorcycle shot dead Sayed Ijaz Hussain, the president of the local branch of the Shi'ite Tehrik-i-Jafria Pakistan (TJP) organisation.
No group claimed responsibility for the killing, which appeared to be the latest episode in a long-running feud between militant Sunni and Shi'ite Moslem groups in Punjab.
More than 110 people have been killed in Sunni-Shi'ite violence, mostly in targeted attacks, in Pakistan this year.
Police have rounded up scores of religious activists in Punjab this week in an effort to contain the vendetta.
Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif told provincial chief ministers at a meeting in Islamabad on Thursday to take immediate steps to curb lawlessness and sectarian violence, newspapers reported.
